title: EARTH is showing off 🌋 | part 12
description: There is a waterfall under the ocean. Part 13 tomorrow.
facts: Lightning strikes our planet millions of times every day.
There is a giant waterfall underwater, near Greenland.
Antarctica is the largest desert on Earth.
One single cloud can weigh more than five hundred tons.
Relative to its size, Earth is smoother than a billiard ball.
outro: Follow for part thirteen. The planet is not done.
